lines.text: Solomon stands before the altar in front of all Israel, spreads his hands toward heaven, and prays to the LORD.
Solomon says God kept His promise to David, yet even the highest heavens cannot contain Him or this temple.
Solomon asks God to hear prayers prayed toward the temple from Zion, His dwelling place.
Solomon asks God to answer a foreigner's prayer so that all peoples will know His name.
Solomon says God brought Israel out of Egypt and set them apart, as He spoke through Samuel.
